verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to. The runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or developer surface at all. The only event-related item is inbound routine triggers from Cursor account integrations (Slack messages, GitHub notifications), which is an adjacent feature, not a webhook subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
